note: Dynamic: {query} is replaced with the confirmed product-identity text at call time via .replace(), NOT str.format(). NEW-market Canadian retail price -> the pricing anchor (resale_listing_ai/adapters.py's retail_price()).
instructions: Find the current NEW-market Canadian retail price, in CAD, for: "{query}". Prefer reputable Canadian retailers. If the best source you find is priced in USD, convert it to CAD yourself and report price_cad as the converted CAD amount (set original_currency to USD so the conversion is auditable). Include a second, corroborating source when a reputable one is available. If reputable sources disagree by more than roughly 10%, note it via a lower confidence_label. If you cannot find a genuine match for this exact product, set match_found to false and leave anchor/corroborating null — never estimate or guess a price.
